reviews.author: Abhinav patil
reviews.text: I had a very good experience with Dr. Adarsh. He is a knowledgeable, caring, and professional orthopaedic doctor. He listened patiently to my concerns and explained the problem and treatment clearly. I really appreciated his calm approach and the time he gave during the consultation. I felt comfortable and confident throughout the treatment. I would definitely recommend Dr. Adarsh to anyone looking for a good orthopaedic specialist.

reviews.author: Cyrus Yadav
reviews.text: I had a very good experience with Dr. Adarsh Patil (Orthopaedic Surgeon). He is knowledgeable, professional, and takes the time to understand the patient’s concerns properly. The consultation was detailed, and he explained the diagnosis and treatment options clearly without rushing. I really appreciated his patient-friendly approach, clinical expertise, and clear communication. The overall experience was smooth and reassuring. I would definitely recommend Dr. Adarsh Patil to anyone looking for a reliable orthopaedic doctor, sports injury specialist, or bone and joint specialist.

reviews.author: Mitalee Khot
reviews.text: Visited Dr.Adarsh Patil for emergency fracture management, and i am very impressed with his expertise. He is a highly skilled orthopaedic surgeon in Navi Mumbai who is calm, attentive, and genuinely cares about his patients. His treatment approach ensured quick healing and full mobility. Excellent doctor for sports injuries, joint pain, and trauma care.
